issues.title: Scheduled Pages deployments serve stale scanner artifacts
issues.description: Scheduled and manual scanner runs reuse one GITHUB_SHA; deploy-pages reports success while Pages can continue serving the previous artifact. Add reliable publication versioning, served-output verification, and per-market candle freshness safeguards.

comments.author: agent
comments.body: Root cause confirmed. Designing the minimal complete fix for unique publication, served-version verification, market freshness reporting, and D1 candle policy.
